title: Api status
description: The body of GET /api/status: everything the status bar and the lamps need in one call. The frontend reads it on every WebSocket open, so a reconnect never leaves the header stale. There is no review feature flag: review is a ticket status, not a route, so there is nothing to switch on.

sim.description: The retained simulator status, null while none has been received.

gateway.description: The retained gateway status, null while none has been received.

backend.description: The backend's own status; it is built in process, so it is always present.

alerts_active.description: The system alerts that are raised right now.

injections_active.description: The fault injections running right now, as the ground-truth overlay reports them. The array is the `active` list of gt-injection-active and is empty when nothing is injected.

gate.description: The two confidence thresholds the decision gate is running with, and the persistence a symptom's evidence needs before it can open a review or a ticket.

ticket_min_confidence.description: The ticket threshold of the running decision backend: JEV_GATE_TICKET_MIN_CONFIDENCE for jev, GATE_TICKET_MIN_CONFIDENCE for rules and llm.

review_min_confidence.description: The review threshold of the running decision backend: JEV_GATE_REVIEW_MIN_CONFIDENCE for jev, GATE_REVIEW_MIN_CONFIDENCE for rules and llm.

persist_sim_min.description: GATE_PERSIST_SIM_MIN, in sim minutes; 0 decides at once. Optional: a backend that predates the parameter does not send it.
